# Primary Dashboard Template

The core tracking artifact. One row per dimension, updated at every learning cycle. Replace the level cell with one of Low (red), Medium (amber), or High (green), and populate every column from project evidence.

Decision: <the named decision this dashboard supports>
Confidence legend: red is Low, amber is Medium, green is High.

| Dimension               | Level                | Evidence                              | Uncertainties                     | Next action                                                    |
|-------------------------|----------------------|---------------------------------------|-----------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| Problem Confidence      | Low / Medium / High  | What evidence supports this level     | What remains unknown              | What the crew will do next to address this dimension           |
| Data Confidence         | Low / Medium / High  |                                       |                                   |                                                                |
| Feasibility Confidence  | Low / Medium / High  |                                       |                                   |                                                                |
| Signal Confidence       | Low / Medium / High  |                                       |                                   |                                                                |
| Applicability Confidence | Low / Medium / High  |                                       |                                   |                                                                |
| Operational Confidence  | Low / Medium / High  |                                       |                                   |                                                                |

Do not add a composite or average row. Each dimension stands on its own.
